rule: YOU CANNOT HAVE AI AS A CO-AUTHOR, OR YOUR CONTRIBUTIONS WILL BE REJECTED.
normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse Unicode whitespace, lowercase. Names match whole normalized names; emails match whole normalized addresses; domains match exact domain or explicit subdomain suffix.
limits: Reviewed aliases only, not universal AI detection or proof of human identity. Strict admission requires a separately reviewed approved identity registry; no organization override can remove canonical prohibitions. Company domains are not classified wholesale as AI identities.
